assay: bulk RNA-seq, gastrocnemius (public dataset, not generated by the authors)
primary_estimand: Effect of 5 weeks of daily treadmill endurance training vs untrained on WT mouse gastrocnemius gene expression, used to test whether EPS genes change in the same direction in vivo
sample_inclusion: TAB1 describes the dataset as 20-week WT C57BL/6J male mice -> WT samples only (n=4 vs 4); Il13-/- samples not used by the paper
planned_contrasts: WT trained vs WT untrained (TAB1; used for classifier testing S2.1.p3 and gene-direction comparison S2.2.p2/FIG3a,b; no DEG count reported)

paper_threshold.note: no DE threshold for public datasets; FIG3 legend only excludes genes with log2 CPM < 1 and sorts by fold difference

paper_method: not stated for public datasets (fold difference of log2 CPM between groups, FIG3 legend)
paper_results: classifier: 83% sed predicted control, 67% ex predicted EPS across 9 datasets (S2.1.p3); exercise signature genes Mt1, Mt2, Atf3 up and Myh4, Fam78a, Ppapdc3, Chrne, Kctd12, Il12a down in at least six datasets (S2.2.p2, FIG3a,b)
